title: ClickHouse Logs & Errors
subtitle: Server log patterns from text_log and failed queries from query_log. Free-form log messages are redacted in the sandbox, but the message_format_string template is kept — so error patterns group cleanly without leaking the values that filled them in.

panels.text:
## Errors with their identifiers, not their stack traces
ClickHouse logs a `message_format_string` template (e.g. `Table {}.{} does not exist...`) plus the positional arguments that fill its `{}` slots in `value1…value10`. This report rebuilds the readable error by folding those args back into the template — so you see `Table system.token_processors does not exist…` with the **real identifiers**, not the raw `message` (which also carries the stack trace, client IP and original query). In the LLM's anonymized copy the args are redacted, so the same row reads `Table [redacted].[redacted] does not exist…` — structure kept, identifiers hidden. Modeled on the *clickhouse-logs* skill; query-level failures are cross-checked against `query_log` exception codes.

panels.query: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM system_anon.text_log WHERE level = 'Error') AS errors, (SELECT count() FROM system_anon.text_log WHERE level = 'Warning') AS warnings, (SELECT countDistinct(message_format_string) FROM system_anon.text_log WHERE level = 'Error' AND notEmpty(message_format_string)) AS error_patterns, (SELECT count() FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE exception_code != 0 AND event_time > now() - 86400) AS failed_queries_24h

panels.title: Top errors (identifiers filled in)
panels.query: SELECT arrayFold((acc, v) -> replaceOne(acc, '{}', v), [value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6, value7, value8, value9, value10], CAST(message_format_string AS String)) AS error, count() AS n, max(event_time) AS last_seen FROM system_anon.text_log WHERE level = 'Error' AND notEmpty(message_format_string) GROUP BY error ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT arrayFold((acc, v) -> replaceOne(acc, '{}', v), [value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6, value7, value8, value9, value10], CAST(message_format_string AS String)) AS error, count() AS n FROM system_anon.text_log WHERE level = 'Error' AND notEmpty(message_format_string) GROUP BY error ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

panels.title: Most frequent errors
panels.template: `{{error}}` occurred {{n|num!}} times — reconstructed from the log template with its identifier arguments filled in.

panels.title: Query failures by error code (24h)
panels.query: SELECT errorCodeToName(exception_code) AS error_name, exception_code AS code, count() AS n FROM system_anon.query_log WHERE exception_code != 0 AND event_time > now() - 86400 GROUP BY error_name, code ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12
